tasks.short: Maintain electrical test, repair and maintenance records.

steps.what: Collect actual electrical test readings, repairs performed and maintenance evidence
Prepare test, repair and maintenance records in the asset-maintenance system

loop.output: draft asset records distinguishing measured findings, actions and unresolved faults
loop.check: Repairer checks asset identity, actual repairs, test values and units, unperformed work and omitted limitations against evidence
loop.stop: Missing test evidence, uncertain asset or one failed retry requires manual entry

steps.what: Check complete final maintenance records against actual work and test evidence
Commit the checked final maintenance records

tasks.short: Analyse electrical test data and system performance.

steps.what: Reconcile actual relay and electrical test measurements with asset and configuration identifiers
Populate specified electrical test plots and performance comparison tables
Interpret test evidence to diagnose faults and assess modification effects
Write and check actual diagnosis, performance findings and limitations
Save the final electrical analysis record

tasks.enabler_now: Native instrument exports and saved analysis views.
tasks.still_hard: Configuration-dependent fault interpretation and modification effects.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether actual evidence supports a safe technical conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated analysis preparation; fault authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native electrical-test imports and plots reduce preparation without diagnosing relay faults or changing protection settings.

tasks.short: Notify facility personnel of equipment shutdowns.

steps.what: Verify actual authorised shutdown scope, equipment identifiers, timing and conditions
Find current affected facility contacts in the approved notification roster
Prepare the exact shutdown message with actual timing, assets and required acknowledgement
Check the complete final shutdown message, recipients and timing against authorisation
outputs: checked final shutdown message and recipients

steps.what: Transmit the checked final shutdown message to affected facility personnel
inputs: checked final shutdown message and recipients

steps.what: Receive and verify actual acknowledgements and resolve misunderstood shutdown details
Record and check actual recipients, notification time and acknowledgement status
Save the actual shutdown notification log
